skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of investment activities in insurance companies, including concepts, necessity, roles, principles, environment, and factors affecting investment activities.
Understand and apply legal regulations, sources of capital, and investment types in financial investments within insurance companies.
Understand and apply financial management principles in insurance companies, including risk analysis and evaluation.
Demonstrate the ability to work in groups, think logically and critically, and take responsibility.
Understand and apply legal regulations governing investment activities in insurance companies.
Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of investment activities in insurance companies.
Develop and implement investment strategies in insurance companies.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate investment activities in insurance companies.
Demonstrate leadership and the ability to inspire and lead groups.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently, creatively, and flexibly, adapting to the business and investment environment of insurance companies.
Demonstrate responsible behavior and a sense of social responsibility.
Understand and comply with legal regulations and organizational rules.
Evaluate risks and performance of investment activities in insurance companies.
Analyze financial performance and profitability of investment activities in insurance companies.
Demonstrate effective presentation skills, including logical and critical thinking.
Conduct research and analyze data related to investment activities in insurance companies.
Collaborate effectively with peers in group projects and discussions.
Apply problem-solving skills to real-world investment scenarios in insurance companies.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and projects.
Adapt to changing environments and conditions in the insurance industry.

prerequisite_courses: Quản trị kinh doanh bảo hiểm 1
